name: VIDYA N Bars Borders Martingale
summary: This EA uses the VIDYA (Variable Index Dynamic Average) indicator to identify trend direction and trades based on N-bars border breakouts. It employs a martingale position sizing strategy that increases lot size after losing trades, aiming to recover losses with a single winning trade.
summary_zh: 该EA使用VIDYA（可变指数动态平均）指标识别趋势方向，基于N根K线边界突破进行交易。它采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，在亏损后加大手数，试图通过一次盈利交易来恢复之前的亏损。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是利用VIDYA指标判断市场趋势方向，当价格突破最近N根K线的最高价或最低价时入场。做多条件为VIDYA趋势向上且价格突破N根K线上轨，做空条件为VIDYA趋势向下且价格突破N根K线下轨。出场条件包括达到止盈目标或止损水平。仓位管理采用马丁格尔策略，每次亏损后将下一单的手数乘以一个倍数因子，试图通过加仓来弥补之前的累计亏损。资金管理方面，EA允许设置最大手数限制和最大马丁格尔层数以控制风险，但仍存在连续亏损后资金急剧膨胀的隐患。整体策略属于趋势跟踪与马丁格尔的结合，在震荡行情中可能面临连续亏损和资金曲线大幅回撤的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept uses the VIDYA indicator to determine market trend direction, entering trades when price breaks above or below the high/low borders of the last N bars. A long entry occurs when VIDYA trends upward and price breaks above the N-bar upper border, while a short entry occurs when VIDYA trends downward and price breaks below the N-bar lower border. Exit conditions include reaching take-profit or stop-loss levels. Position sizing follows a martingale strategy, multiplying the lot size by a factor after each losing trade to recover accumulated losses with a single win. Money management includes configurable maximum lot size and maximum martingale levels to limit risk exposure, but the inherent danger of exponentially increasing position sizes after consecutive losses remains. The strategy combines trend-following with martingale recovery, which can lead to severe drawdowns and account depletion during prolonged ranging or whipsaw markets.

parameters.name: N_Bars
parameters.description: 用于计算价格边界的K线数量
parameters.description_en: Number of bars for price boundary calculation

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: 马丁格尔倍数因子，亏损后手数乘以此值
parameters.description_en: Martingale multiplier factor applied after loss

parameters.name: MaxMartingaleLevel
parameters.description: 最大马丁格尔层数限制

pros: VIDYA指标相比普通均线具有自适应波动率的特性，能更好地适应市场变化
N根K线边界突破逻辑清晰，提供了客观的入场信号
设置了最大马丁格尔层数和最大手数限制，一定程度上控制了极端风险
趋势过滤加突破入场的组合策略在趋势行情中有较好的表现
参数可配置性强，交易者可以根据不同品种和周期调整策略
pros_en: VIDYA indicator adapts to market volatility better than simple moving averages due to its variable index mechanism
N-bars border breakout logic provides clear and objective entry signals
Maximum martingale level and lot size caps provide some protection against unlimited position escalation
Combining trend filter with breakout entry performs well in trending markets
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to adapt the strategy to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 马丁格尔策略本质上是高风险的，连续亏损会导致手数指数级增长，可能爆仓
没有考虑点差和滑点对短线交易的影响，在波动剧烈时实际成本可能远超预期
策略在震荡行情中会频繁触发假突破导致连续亏损，触发马丁格尔序列
缺乏整体资金管理模块，未根据账户余额动态调整风险敞口
出场机制较为单一，仅依赖固定止盈止损，未考虑移动止损或趋势反转退出
cons_en: Martingale strategy is inherently high-risk; consecutive losses cause exponential lot size growth that can wipe out the account
No spread or slippage filter is applied, which can significantly increase real trading costs during volatile periods
Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets trigger consecutive losses and activate the martingale sequence
Lacks an overall money management module that dynamically adjusts risk exposure based on account equity
Exit mechanism is simplistic with fixed TP/SL only, without trailing stop or trend-reversal exit logic
improvements: 增加账户余额百分比的资金管理模块，根据净值动态调整初始手数
添加移动止损机制和趋势反转退出条件，保护已获利润
增加点差过滤和波动率过滤，避免在高成本或低流动性时段交易
考虑用部分马丁格尔或反马丁格尔替代纯马丁格尔，降低连续亏损风险
improvements_en: Add an account equity percentage-based money management module that dynamically adjusts initial lot size
Implement trailing stop and trend-reversal exit conditions to protect accumulated profits
Add spread and volatility filters to avoid trading during high-cost or low-liquidity periods
Consider replacing pure martingale with partial martingale or anti-martingale to reduce consecutive loss risk

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损后手数指数增长，可能导致账户爆仓
没有点差过滤和滑点保护，实际执行成本可能严重偏离预期
缺乏整体资金管理，未根据账户净值动态调整仓位规模
固定止盈止损未考虑市场波动率变化，可能在不适当水平被触发
risk_points_en: Martingale lot escalation after consecutive losses can lead to account blow-up
No spread filter or slippage protection means actual execution costs may severely deviate from expectations
Lacks holistic money management with no dynamic position sizing based on account equity
Fixed TP/SL ignores market volatility changes and may be triggered at inappropriate levels
